what: A single symbol character like an asterisk (*) spins constantly at −32° per second around the center of its own ink, speeds up by the scrolled amount (.5°/s per 1px), then returns to its own speed by 1 − e^(−1.6·dt) each frame (−170 to −9°/s). The axis is the center of the ink box of the symbol drawn on canvas with the same font, so it spins in place even if the font changes.

options.speed: Resting rotation per second (°/s), default −32 (negative turns left)
options.gain: Speed added per 1px of scroll (°/s), default .5 — scrolling down speeds it up further toward speed
options.back: Rate of return to own speed (1/s), default 1.6
options.min · max: Speed range (°/s), default −170 · −9 — if speed is changed to positive, the range follows

note: with reduce, only the axis is measured and nothing is rotated

from.where: index.html work list ”Archive” row end vermilion asterisk (original Gallery .g-star — measures the text on a canvas to set transform-origin and spins it with a ticker)
